properties.displayName: Conditional Access Bypass - Open Gate or Legacy Auth Success
properties.description:
Detects successful sign-ins that bypassed Conditional Access, either structurally (legacy / non-modern auth that grant controls cannot reach) or functionally (an enabled CA policy reported failure but the sign-in still succeeded). Unions interactive and non-interactive sign-in logs, normalizes nested device/location/status fields, excludes report-only policy results, suppresses benign status codes, enriches with a 1-day CA-failure grind baseline and UEBA identity context, then scores each result with a composite RiskIndicators field.

TABLES: SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, IdentityInfo
CONNECTORS: Microsoft Entra ID (Diagnostic Settings - SignInLogs, NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs), Microsoft Sentinel UEBA (IdentityInfo)
LICENSE: Microsoft Sentinel (Log Analytics workspace) + Microsoft Entra ID P1 (CA logs); P2 recommended (sign-in risk, UEBA / IdentityInfo)

TUNING:
1. LegacyAuthClients list - which ClientAppUsed values count as legacy; trim to what you have not yet blocked
2. SensitiveApps list - optional allowlist of AppDisplayName/ResourceDisplayName to focus on; empty = all apps
3. BenignErrorCodes list - status/error codes to suppress; replaces the original ConditionalAccessBenignStatusCodes watchlist
4. GrindThreshold - prior-failure count that sets PrecededByRepeatedFailures
5. DetectionWindow - keep aligned to the rule run frequency

KNOWN FALSE POSITIVES:
1. Sanctioned service mailboxes or scanners still using legacy protocols - add to an exclusion or SensitiveApps inversion
2. Migration / coexistence tooling authenticating over EWS or Exchange Online PowerShell - baseline and exclude by app
3. Report-only policies are excluded by design; verify if your tenant runs heavily in report-only
4. Single-factor successes on apps genuinely outside any MFA policy - tune SensitiveApps to focus the SingleFactorOnly signal

INVESTIGATION STEPS:
1. Check Signal - LegacyAuthSuccess (structural) vs FailOpenControl (a policy reported failure yet sign-in succeeded).
2. Review RiskIndicators - ControlFailedButSignInSucceeded + ElevatedSignInRisk + SingleFactorOnly together = immediate escalation.
3. For FailOpenControl, examine FailedPolicy / FailedPolicyResult - which enforcing policy did not engage, and why.
4. For LegacyAuthSuccess, confirm whether the ClientAppUsed protocol is expected for this user/app or should be blocked.
5. Check PriorCAFailures / DistinctFailingIPs - a bypass preceded by repeated failures suggests a grind into a gap.
6. Review RiskLevelDuringSignIn, IPAddress, City/Country and DeviceId against the user's normal pattern.
7. If IsServiceAccount is true, validate the app/protocol is a sanctioned automation path; otherwise treat as suspicious.
8. Correlate CorrelationId across SigninLogs for the full authentication chain.

BLIND SPOTS:
Does not detect CA policy configuration tampering (disable/scope changes) - build the companion AuditLogs detection for that. Report-only policy results are intentionally excluded. Bypasses that produce no sign-in log (e.g. token replay outside these tables) are not covered. IdentityInfo UEBA columns silently return empty if UEBA is not enabled.

Author: Bartosz Wysocki | https://www.itprofessor.cloud
Version: 1.0 | 2026-06-15
properties.query:
// =====================================================================
// Conditional Access Bypass - Open Gate or Legacy Auth Success
// =====================================================================
// Tables : SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, IdentityInfo
// License : Microsoft Sentinel + Microsoft Entra ID P1 (P2 recommended)
// Tuning : see rule description for full tuning notes
// Author : Bartosz Wysocki | itprofessor.cloud
// Version : 1.0 | 2026-06-15
// =====================================================================
let LegacyAuthClients = dynamic([
"Other clients",
"IMAP4",
"POP3",
"SMTP",
"Authenticated SMTP",
"MAPI",
"Exchange ActiveSync",
"Exchange Web Services",
"Exchange Online PowerShell",
"AutoDiscover"
]);
let SensitiveApps = dynamic([]); // empty = evaluate all apps; populate to focus SensitiveAppAccessed
let BenignErrorCodes = dynamic(["50140"]); // example: 'keep me signed in' interrupt; tune for your environment
let GrindThreshold = 5;
let DetectionWindow = 1h;
// Normalizer: flatten the nested device / location / status fields once, reuse per branch
let NormalizeSignins = (tableName:string) {
 table(tableName)
 | extend CAPolicies = parse_json(ConditionalAccessPolicies),
 DeviceDetailJson = todynamic(DeviceDetail),
 LocationJson = todynamic(LocationDetails),
 StatusJson = todynamic(Status)
 | extend OS = tostring(DeviceDetailJson.operatingSystem),
 Browser = tostring(DeviceDetailJson.browser),
 DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetailJson.deviceId),
 IsCompliant = tostring(DeviceDetailJson.isCompliant),
 City = tostring(LocationJson.city),
 State = tostring(LocationJson.state),
 Country = tostring(LocationJson.countryOrRegion),
 StatusErrorCode = tostring(StatusJson.errorCode),
 StatusDetails = tostring(StatusJson.additionalDetails),
 SourceTable = tableName
};
// Grind context: CA failures per user over 1d, keyed on stable UserId (not user agent)
let GrindBaseline = SigninLogs
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
 | where ConditionalAccessStatus =~ "failure"
 | summarize PriorCAFailures = count(), DistinctFailingIPs = dcount(IPAddress) by UserId;
let IdentityContext = IdentityInfo
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
 | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AccountUPN
 | project AccountUPN, AccountCreationTime, Department, JobTitle, Manager, AssignedRoles, IsMFARegistered, IsAccountEnabled, IsServiceAccount, EntityRiskScore, UserType;
// --- Branch A: structural bypass - legacy / non-modern auth that SUCCEEDED ---
// This is the branch where the non-interactive table earns its place
let LegacyBypass = union isfuzzy=true
 (NormalizeSignins("SigninLogs")),
 (NormalizeSignins("AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs"))
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(DetectionWindow)
 | where ResultType == "0"
 | where ClientAppUsed in~ (LegacyAuthClients)
 | extend Signal = "LegacyAuthSuccess", FailedPolicy = "", FailedPolicyResult = "";
// --- Branch B: functional bypass - enabled CA policy reported failure but sign-in SUCCEEDED ---
// Interactive only; report-only results are excluded so we only see enforcing policies
let FailOpenBypass = NormalizeSignins("SigninLogs")
 | where TimeGenerated > ago(DetectionWindow)
 | where ResultType == "0"
 | mv-apply CAP = CAPolicies on (
 where tostring(CAP.result) =~ "failure"
 and isnotempty(CAP.enforcedGrantControls)
 | project FailedPolicy = tostring(CAP.displayName),
 FailedPolicyResult = tostring(CAP.result)
 )
 | extend Signal = "FailOpenControl";
// --- Combine, filter benign, enrich, score ---
union LegacyBypass, FailOpenBypass
| where StatusErrorCode !in (BenignErrorCodes)
| join kind=leftouter GrindBaseline on UserId
| extend PriorCAFailures = coalesce(PriorCAFailures, 0), DistinctFailingIPs = coalesce(DistinctFailingIPs, 0)
| join kind=leftouter IdentityContext on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.AccountUPN
| extend TargetAccountAgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), AccountCreationTime)
| extend Name = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[0]), UPNSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1])
| extend Risk_1 = iff(Signal == "LegacyAuthSuccess", "LegacyAuthBypass", "")
| extend Risk_2 = iff(Signal == "FailOpenControl", "ControlFailedButSignInSucceeded", "")
| extend Risk_3 = iff(tolower(tostring(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)) in ("high", "medium"), "ElevatedSignInRisk", "")
| extend Risk_4 = iff(AuthenticationRequirement =~ "singleFactorAuthentication", "SingleFactorOnly", "")
| extend Risk_5 = iff(PriorCAFailures >= GrindThreshold, "PrecededByRepeatedFailures", "")
| extend Risk_6 = iff(IsServiceAccount == true, "TargetIsServiceAccount", "")
| extend Risk_7 = iff(array_length(SensitiveApps) > 0 and (AppDisplayName in~ (SensitiveApps) or ResourceDisplayName in~ (SensitiveApps)), "SensitiveAppAccessed", "")
| extend RiskIndicators = trim(@"\s\|\s*$", strcat(
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_1), strcat(Risk_1, " | "), ""),
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_2), strcat(Risk_2, " | "), ""),
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_3), strcat(Risk_3, " | "), ""),
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_4), strcat(Risk_4, " | "), ""),
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_5), strcat(Risk_5, " | "), ""),
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_6), strcat(Risk_6, " | "), ""),
 iff(isnotempty(Risk_7), strcat(Risk_7, " | "), "")
))
| project
 TimeGenerated, Signal, RiskIndicators,
 UserPrincipalName, Name, UPNSuffix, UserId,
 AppDisplayName, ResourceDisplayName, ClientAppUsed,
 ResultType, ResultDescription, ConditionalAccessStatus,
 FailedPolicy, FailedPolicyResult,
 AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState,
 IPAddress, City, State, Country, OS, Browser, DeviceId, IsCompliant,
 StatusErrorCode, StatusDetails,
 PriorCAFailures, DistinctFailingIPs,
 Department, JobTitle, Manager, AssignedRoles,
 IsMFARegistered, IsAccountEnabled, IsServiceAccount, EntityRiskScore, UserType, TargetAccountAgeDays,
 CorrelationId, SourceTable, Id
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Risk flags: {{RiskIndicators}} | Client app: {{ClientAppUsed}} | Source IP: {{IPAddress}}
